name: OWA and mobile device mailbox policies
description: Lists Outlook on the web mailbox policies and mobile device mailbox policies with whether each is the default and its key settings.
prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read organisation configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Only key settings are summarised; allowed and blocked file type lists are counted, not listed.
A setting not returned, or returned null, is Unknown; one returned empty is NotSet; a list returned empty is 0.
Which mailboxes use each policy is not read here: that needs one read per mailbox.
Conditional Access and Intune app protection policies, which can also govern these clients, are not read.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
